description: This file contains unit tests for the ElevenLabsTTSClient class, specifically testing methods related to validating output formats, language codes, and normalization values.

classes.name: ElevenLabsTTSValidationTests
classes.description: A test case class for validating the behavior of ElevenLabsTTSClient's validation methods.

methods.name: testValidatedOutputFormatAllowsOnlyMp3Presets
methods.description: Tests that the validatedOutputFormat method correctly accepts valid MP3 presets and normalizes or rejects other inputs.

methods.name: testValidatedLanguageAcceptsTwoLetterCodes
methods.description: Tests that the validatedLanguage method accepts valid two-letter language codes and rejects other formats.

methods.name: testValidatedNormalizeAcceptsKnownValues
methods.description: Tests that the validatedNormalize method accepts known normalization values and rejects unrecognized ones.
